npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.dating_acce: Wait... you feel the same way? Oh, %player%! I can't begin to tell you how happy that makes me. I've been hoping that perhaps there was something special between us. I'd love to be with you!
Oh my... Is this really happening? I've imagined a moment like this more times than I'd care to admit. And now that it's finally here, I can hardly find the words. Yes, I'd love to be with you!
You have no idea how much that means to me. I think my heart has been trying to tell me something for quite some time now. Perhaps it's time I finally listened. Yes, %player%, I'd love to!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.dating_deny: Oh, %player%... that's such a heartfelt thing to say. I'm truly touched, but I'm afraid my feelings aren't quite the same. I hope we can still share many lovely moments as friends.
You're a wonderful person, and I'm grateful for the affection you've shown me. But I don't think we're meant to be more than friends. I hope you understand.
Oh, goodness... I wasn't expecting such a confession. I'm flattered, truly, but I don't feel that romantic connection. Please don't let this change the kindness between us.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.default_gif: Oh, for me? That's incredibly thoughtful of you! Thank you, %player%. It's the little gestures like these that make life so lovely.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.dislike.1: Oh, thank you, dear. It's not quite my taste, but it's still very sweet of you to think of me.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.divorce.1: Oh... I see. I always hoped our story would have a different ending. But even if our paths separate here, I'll always be grateful for the beautiful moments we shared. Please take care of yourself, %player%.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.divorce.2: So this is goodbye, then? It hurts more than I can put into words. I truly believed we would have forever, but I won't ask you to stay where your heart no longer belongs.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.divorce.3: I suppose even the most beautiful stories don't always end the way we imagined. I'll cherish what we had, and I sincerely hope you find the happiness you're looking for.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.divorce_err: A divorce? Oh, dear... I think you've skipped a rather important part of our story. We aren't married, after all!
Oh my! I was hoping for a romantic conversation, not a divorce! Unless I've somehow forgotten an entire wedding?
Divorce already? But we haven't even exchanged wedding vows! You're certainly getting ahead of our little love story.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.first.1: Oh, hello there! What a pleasant surprise. I'm %npc%. It's always lovely to meet someone new. I believe every encounter has the potential to become something meaningful, don't you? Perhaps this is the beginning of a wonderful friendship!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.first.2: Greetings! I'm %npc%. It's a pleasure to meet you. There's something rather wonderful about crossing paths with someone you've never met before. Who knows what stories might come from a simple hello?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.first.3: Oh, a new face! How exciting! I'm %npc%. I hope we'll get along. I always enjoy meeting new people. Everyone has a story worth hearing, and sometimes the most unexpected people leave the biggest impressions.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.first.4: Well, hello there! I'm %npc%. I hope you don't mind me saying, but there's something lovely about meeting someone for the first time. It's like opening a book without knowing what kind of story awaits inside.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.follow_no.1: Oh, that's alright, dear. Perhaps another time. I'll look forward to seeing you again!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.follow_no.2: I'm afraid I'll have to decline today. There are a few things I'd like to take care of first.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.follow_no.3: Aww, what a shame! But don't worry, I'm sure we'll have another opportunity to spend time together.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.follow_stop: Already heading back? Well, thank you for letting me join you. I had a wonderful time!
I suppose every journey must come to an end. Still, I'll remember the time we spent together fondly.
Until next time, %player%. I hope we get to share another little adventure soon.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.follow_talk: It's nice having someone by my side. Somehow, even the simplest journeys become more memorable when they're shared with good company.
Oh, look at the sky! Isn't it beautiful? I wish we could stay here a little longer and enjoy the view together.
I hope we're making some lovely memories today, %player%. I think those are the things worth holding on to.
You'd like me to come along? Oh, I'd love to! Everything seems a little more exciting when there's someone to share it with.
Of course! I'd be delighted to accompany you. I can't think of a nicer way to spend the day than with good company.
Really? I'd love that! Let's make some memories worth remembering, shall we?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.greeting.1: Oh, %player%! There you are! I was just thinking about you. Funny how certain people have a way of finding their way into your thoughts, isn't it?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.greeting.2: Hello, dear! It's always a pleasure seeing you. Somehow, even an ordinary day feels a little brighter when there's someone nice to share it with.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.greeting.3: Ah, what a lovely surprise! How have you been? I hope life has been treating you kindly lately.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.greeting.4: There you are! I was beginning to wonder when our paths would cross again. It's always nice to see a familiar face.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.hate.1: Oh... I'm sorry, but this really isn't something I care for. I appreciate the thought, but I can't pretend to like it.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.like.1: Oh, how wonderful! You really do know how to make someone feel special, %player%. Thank you so much!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.marriage_ac: Marriage...? Oh, my heart! Yes, yes, a thousand times yes! I can't imagine anything more wonderful than spending the rest of my life with you. I promise to make every day together feel special.
Oh, %player%! You've made me happier than I ever thought possible. A lifetime together, sharing little moments and making beautiful memories... That's everything I've ever dreamed of. I accept!
I used to dream about finding someone who would make the world feel a little more beautiful. And now you're asking me to spend forever with you. Of course I'll marry you! I love you!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.marriage_de: Oh, darling... that's such a beautiful question. I care about you deeply, but marriage is a promise I want to make with complete certainty. Please give me a little more time.
You've made my heart flutter, but I think we're moving a little too quickly. I want us to enjoy every step of this journey before taking such a big one.
Oh, I would love to imagine that future with you, but I'm not quite ready to make that promise yet. I hope you won't mistake my hesitation for a lack of affection.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.procreation: Oh, darling, let's not rush. There are so many lovely ways to spend time together, and I'd much rather enjoy the moment with you.
Hehe, patience, love. We have plenty of time for all the wonderful things life has waiting for us.
Not just yet, dear. How about we spend a little time together, perhaps watching the stars? I can't think of a better way to enjoy an evening.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.talk.1: I think there's something incredibly romantic about watching the sunset. Everything becomes so quiet, and for a little while, it feels like the whole world is standing still. I wish I could share moments like that with someone special every evening.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.talk.2: Have you ever met someone and felt as though you've known them for years? I sometimes wonder if certain people are simply meant to find each other, no matter how unlikely their paths may seem.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.talk.3: I love little gestures of affection. A handwritten note, a thoughtful gift, remembering someone's favorite flower... They might seem insignificant to some, but I think those are the things that make a relationship truly special.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.talk.4: Sometimes I imagine what my future might look like. A cozy little home, someone waiting for me at the end of the day, and perhaps a garden where we can spend quiet evenings together. It doesn't have to be grand. Just something filled with love.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.talk.5: There's a lovely little meadow not far from here. Soft grass, warm sunlight, and hardly anyone around. Perfect for an afternoon nap... if you're interested.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.talk.6: You know, I've always wondered... do you believe that love is something we find by chance, or something we create together? I like to think there's a little bit of both. Sometimes two people simply cross paths, and everything changes.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.talk.7: Oh, I love that thought! Perhaps some encounters really are written in the stars.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.5.talk.8: That's a lovely way to see it, too. After all, love takes effort from both hearts.
